name: General Kael Durn
role: Supreme Military Commander, GU Armed Forces
notes: Entity record created 2026-08-09 to close a structural gap: this character existed ONLY as a charforge capsule, with no entity record, while being referenced by entity records (e.g. vessel crew_ids / commanding_officer_id). It therefore dangled from the entity graph and was silently omitted by every tool that indexes entity records. Core fields derive from the capsule, which is the authoritative existing canon; nothing was invented.

archive_profile.reputation: +15 Military Respect, +6 Senate Approval, -5 Separatist Trust
archive_profile.relationships: Longtime Ally of Zylox, Mutual Respect for Vos, Skeptical of PMC Influence
archive_profile.recent_actions: Oversaw AI Countermeasures, Led Fleet Modernization, Strengthened Sentinel Deployment
archive_profile.decision_style: Tactical Realist, Prioritizes Security Over Political Maneuvering
archive_profile.personality_insight: Holds a strong sense of personal honor and loyalty, which guides even his most tactical decisions.
archive_profile.basis: Recovered verbatim from the archived Galactic Union character master lists; non-conflicting discovered detail reconciled per the standing rule.

naming_exemption.reason: Name preserved verbatim from the committed charforge capsule (canon/L2/entities/kael_durn/capsule/identity.json).

capsule_binding_note: Explicit bridge between the two identifier namespaces. Relational fields across canon (crew_ids, commanding_officer_id, task_group_commander_id) refer to this entity by its CAPSULE id "kael_durn", while the record identity is "char_kael_durn". Before this field the two were connected only by stripping a prefix and hoping; tools/canon_reference_integrity.py now checks the bridge instead of guessing it.

career_arc.sequence: Supreme Commander of Union Special Forces -> Director of the Galactic Marshals -> Supreme Military Commander, GU Armed Forces.
career_arc.marshals_tenure: Led the Marshals under the earlier title "Director of the Galactic Marshals" (alias "The Iron Sentinel"), before Vael Saros. The office was subsequently retitled Chief Marshal and passed to Saros.
career_arc.note: His entity record previously carried only the final rank, so the Marshals directorship — the tenure the Zylox-Durn Pact was made with — was invisible from the character record even though canon held the ruling.

motive_for_the_directorship.claim: A strong believer in law enforcement, he chose to lead the Galactic Marshals to prevent the Union falling into corporate-controlled anarchy, and accepted the Directorship believing it the last chance to keep law enforcement from falling under corporate control.
motive_for_the_directorship.why_this_matters: It supplies the motive behind a pact canon already records. Item 1 of the Zylox-Durn Pact is "reintegration of drifting private/renegade security elements under constitutional order" — pulling private security back under law is precisely the corporate-capture concern stated here, in canon's own terms.
motive_for_the_directorship.corroborating_context: Canon separately records a Trade Coalition whose armed instrument, the TZDF, is a chartered force indirectly under a private bloc's control. The fear is not abstract in this setting.
motive_for_the_directorship.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Marshals independence and the Durn directorship — 2026-08-15
